provider.name: EphemeralStatePort binding (hobo.core.ephemeral-state/v1): in-memory, Valkey/Redis over RESP, Upstash REST, libSQL, Vercel Blob

metadata.note: The port calls ephemeralAssignmentReplica makes against one backend's ephemeral-state store, in order, with the stored value (a FleetAssignmentLog in protobuf JSON) and the port's answers. Pinned on purpose: the read-check-conditional-write sequence (get, then putIfAbsent on an absent key or compareAndSet on the version read) is the replica's atomicity argument, and the TTL is the port's 30-day cap. Versions are opaque tokens; the provider side runs on the in-memory binding with a fixed incarnation (inc-1) and clock (1800000000000).

interactions.description: read of a backend that holds no log: one get of the log key, absent
interactions.providerState: the log key does not exist

interactions.description: accept epoch 1 on an empty log: read the key first
interactions.providerState: the log key does not exist

interactions.description: accept epoch 1 on an empty log: a create-only write of the one-entry log with the 30-day TTL
interactions.providerState: the log key does not exist

interactions.description: accept epoch 2: read the log and its version
interactions.providerState: the log holds epoch 1 at version inc-1:1

interactions.description: accept epoch 2: compare-and-set on the version read, appending the entry and resetting the TTL
interactions.providerState: the log holds epoch 1 at version inc-1:1

interactions.description: accept the same epoch 2 entry again: one read, no write (duplicate)
interactions.providerState: the log holds epochs 1 and 2 at version inc-1:2

interactions.description: accept epoch 4: one read, no write (gap)
interactions.providerState: the log holds epochs 1 and 2 at version inc-1:2

interactions.description: read the newest entry: one get
interactions.providerState: the log holds epochs 1 and 2 at version inc-1:2

interactions.description: refresh: reset the log's TTL without writing it
interactions.providerState: the log holds epochs 1 and 2 at version inc-1:2

interactions.description: seed a log that is not empty: the create-only write is refused
interactions.providerState: the log holds epochs 1 and 2 at version inc-1:2
